data.body: E06-01 remains open. In the caller-owned errorLedger branch, any existing item with the same order suppresses the new serialized occurrence, even when it is a different record. For example, with a preserved caller errorLedger containing an unrelated record at order 2, recording a primary and then a frame/close failure gives the latter order 2 and prevents its serialized record from being exposed. The original caller record survives, but the new occurrence's phase, stack and frameUrl sidecar are missing from primary.errorLedger; if the measured JSON attachment also fails, that exposed ledger cannot provide the required complete diagnostics. Caller orders and this ledger's orders are independent namespaces; preserve existing objects and track this ledger's appended serialized objects by identity instead of deduplicating by order.
data.title: E06-01 Deduplicate caller ledger records by identity, not order
